text:
Sam Carter: Morning — prepping orion-12b AWQ canary. quick asks: weights checkpoint location? tokenizer edge-case noted in evals? need signoff for calib dataset.
Priya Nair: weights uploaded to s3://redwood-models/orion-12b/v2/checkpoints.tar.gz. Miguel and I verified checksums.
Miguel Alvarez: checksum: `sha256:a3b5f8c9e2d4f6a7b8c9d0e1f2a3b4c5d6e7f8a9b0c1d2e3f4a5b6c7d8e9f0c1` — included in release notes. tokenizer vocab has two legacy tokens that break BPE merges on our tokenizer: `<|custom|>` and `<<EOS>>`.
Jen Li: noted. are those coming from the orig repo or from our conversion script?
Miguel Alvarez: conversion. fix is small but affects a small fraction of calib prompts (long tail).
Sam Carter: ok — is the fix backwards compatible? can we patch tokenizer on the fly for hosted?
Priya Nair: yes, we can add a normalization step in the tokenizer wrapper: replace `<<EOS>>` -> `
` and normalize `<|custom|>` -> `<|custom_v2|>`.
Sam Carter: add that to config and CI. pinging @deploy-bot for canary scheduling. Also we need calibration dataset signoff: calib-bucket path is s3://redwood-calib/orion-12b/2026-03-10/ ; size 12GB.
calib-bot: [auto] calib dataset checks: token-length-dist OK, no PII patterns found, sampling stratified across domains.
Jen Li: accuracy tradeoff note — AWQ baseline drops ~0.8% vs FP16 on our eval set, GPTQ about ~0.5% drop but lower inference cost. FP8 profile (experimental) shows ~1.5% drop but 2.3x token/s improvement.
Sam Carter: tradeoff logged. recommended: start with GPTQ-mix for canary, enable FP8 only after acceptance. Need approvals from Eng-ML leads.
Priya Nair: I'm fine with GPTQ-mix for canary. leave FP8 behind a flag.
Miguel Alvarez: LGTM, but add a note in release notes about the tokenizer normalization and the checksum.
Jen Li: approved from QA side, will run smoke eval after canary is up.
Sam Carter: OK — @Miguel please open the small PR for tokenizer wrapper + config with the canary params and tag reviewers `@Priya @Jen`. Include the config snippet: 
```
model:
  name: orion-12b
  quant: gptq-mix
  tokenizer:
    normalizations:
      - replace: {'<<EOS>>':'\n'}
      - replace: {'<|custom|>':'<|custom_v2|>'}
calib:
  dataset: s3://redwood-calib/orion-12b/2026-03-10/
  profile: default_smoke
```
Priya Nair: will review PR today.
deploy-bot: scheduled canary for orion-12b v2 at 2026-03-12T16:00Z (window 30m) — status: queued.
Sam Carter: thanks all, will follow-up with rollout checklist in the PR. :thumbsup:
